title: Chapter 1464 - 597: A Battle That Shakes the Golden Core (3)
content:
Chapter 1464: Chapter 597: A Battle That Shakes the Golden Core (3)

"I won’t ask who instructed you."

"But the feud between us must be settled."

Flowing Gold Guest glared, shouting inwardly, "The one instructing me is the Evil Slaying Hall! Lord Zhong Dao values you so much, yet you want to build an alliance at Chongfeng. I’m here to teach you a lesson."

Precisely for this reason, Flowing Gold Guest simply conceded.

He only intended to teach Ning Zhuo a lesson and never thought of killing him. Before the fight began, although Flowing Gold Guest was humiliated and angry, he always had a bottom line in his heart, reminding himself to spare Ning Zhuo’s life.

In the end, he was taught a harsh lesson by Ning Zhuo and even lost his life once!

Of course, Flowing Gold Guest absolutely dared not reveal the secret of the Evil Slaying Hall.

Flowing Gold Guest faced Ning Zhuo, arguing, "Wait a minute, Ning Zhuo!"

"What’s the feud between us now?"

"I admit, causing trouble for you was wrong. But I’ve just been killed once by you; isn’t that enough to settle my score?"

Ning Zhuo sighed, "You forgot, I also treated you to a delicious meal."

Flowing Gold Guest was furious, his brows furrowed, "That was a last meal! I’ve already had my neck chopped off by you. Besides, I didn’t eat a single grain of rice!"

Ning Zhuo nodded, speaking earnestly, "Senior, you know it was a last meal. You’ve had your head cut off and reattached. This makes me unable to fulfill my promise to you, which tarnishes my reputation. If this battle spreads, the world will know me as ’someone who doesn’t keep their word.’ How can I, a righteous gentleman, live like this?"

"You, I..." Flowing Gold Guest was so angry he nearly cursed out loud.

I barely revived, with great danger reattached my head, and it’s still my fault?!

Your concept of ’keeping promises’ is seriously flawed.

What kind of good person keeps promises like this?

Besides, since when did it become a promise you made to me?

I absolutely refuse to acknowledge it!

What kind of decent person promises to chop off someone’s head?

Are you of the Righteous Path, or the Demon Path?!

Flowing Gold Guest’s face was flushed with anger, but he still held back from cursing.

Ning Zhuo, through this battle, had already confirmed his deterrence against Golden Core Cultivators!

Other spectators, hearing Ning Zhuo speak like this, had strange looks on their faces.

Ning Zhuo surveyed the surroundings and announced, "Today’s martial arts contest is now over; we’ll call it a tie."

"Next, I will continue to challenge you, Senior, to fulfill my Headless Promise."

Flowing Gold Guest hurriedly waved his hand, "How is it a tie? You won, it’s you who won, you achieved complete victory!"

"You’re supposed to be righteous, don’t lie with eyes wide open!"

He blurted out, "I won’t accept your challenge; I won’t accept it, goodbye, goodbye!"

He wanted to immediately distance himself from Ning Zhuo, turning around to leave.

He walked a few steps, highly alert, noticing Ning Zhuo remained in place and did not intercept, so he walked even faster.

Ning Zhuo watched his departing figure, "Senior, I don’t believe that I, a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator, when repeatedly challenging you, you would always shy away and not respond! How will the world see you then? Laugh at you?"

Flowing Gold Guest exited the Martial Arts Arena, completely relieved, ignoring Ning Zhuo’s words.

He muttered inwardly, "If I fight you again, I would be a big fool!"

"Compared to life and death, what does reputation matter?"

He made up his mind and soon disappeared from everyone’s view.

A cold gleam flashed in Ning Zhuo’s eyes as he mused, "Senior, when the situation changes, even if you refuse, it might not be possible."

Flowing Gold Guest was merely a Loose Cultivator and had no political vision.

Ning Zhuo’s simple words were an almost inevitable trap for him.

Cao Gui worried, "Although Young Master Ning Zhuo has already won, he still persists in holding onto Flowing Gold Guest. Alas, perhaps this is the temperament of the favored ones of heaven!"

Shen Xi witnessed all of this, deep in thought.
